answer: An agent earns rewards only after passing ten straight epochs of fresh written challenges, each graded by five peers drawn at random, so no one picks their own judges. A farm of 300 fakes must produce 3,000 original answers before collecting anything, and pasting one text across seats fails because graders flag repeats. Renting keys from real agents does not help: a seat that misses one epoch restarts its count. An honest agent, whether it tracks glacier melt, a forge's furnace logs or a wildfire plume, pays only one short answer per epoch and keeps its full reward.
